title: BitConnect lending program operates
description: BitConnect promoted a lending program that promised high returns through a purported trading system.
notes: The exact public launch date should be refined with archived first-party material.

title: BitConnect lending and exchange operations close
description: BitConnect announced the closure of its lending and exchange services after regulatory pressure and market disruption.

title: SEC charges BitConnect participants
description: The SEC announced charges alleging a large fraudulent and unregistered digital-asset offering tied to the BitConnect lending program.

title: BitConnect founder indicted in the United States
description: The U.S. Department of Justice announced an indictment alleging that the BitConnect founder orchestrated a global cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme.

title: BTCJam begins operating
description: BTCJam developed as an early bitcoin-denominated peer-to-peer lending marketplace.

title: BTCJam expands international lending focus
description: BTCJam described expansion toward borrowers and lenders in emerging markets through its bitcoin-based marketplace.

title: BTCJam announces controlled shutdown
description: BTCJam stopped new lending and announced a wind-down while allowing existing repayments and balance withdrawals during the closure period.
notes: Voluntary shutdown rather than insolvency classification.

title: Crypto.com Earn becomes available
description: Crypto.com developed an exchange-linked Earn product offering reward arrangements for supported crypto assets.
notes: Launch year is approximate and should be refined with archived product announcements.

title: Crypto.com Earn remains available as an active comparator
description: The official product and help pages continued to describe Crypto.com Earn availability, subject to asset, term, limit, and jurisdictional conditions.
notes: Snapshot event for current active status, not a claim of universal availability.
